title: Softer Requests: Quisiera, Pudiera, Debiera
goal: Review the polite -ra forms quisiera, pudiera and debiera and add quisiera que + imperfect subjunctive.
grammar: Polite forms with the imperfect subjunctive

items: I can soften a request with quisiera, pudiera and debiera.
I can ask someone to do something with quisiera que + imperfect subjunctive.
I can use the new words for offices and forms.
